description: Stop a running trading bot immediately. The bot stops trading entirely: any positions it currently holds stay open but are left unmanaged (no stop loss / take profit handling, no strategy exits) — close those separately with close_position. For a graceful stop that keeps managing the open position and pauses once it closes, use update_bot with stopAfterClose: true instead. The bot and its config are kept and can be restarted later (with start_bot), so this is a reversible state change, not a delete. Check state first with get_bot_status; find bot IDs with list_bots.

id.description: The bot ID to stop, obtained from list_bots.

name: stop_bot
